Local situado en la calle de La Palma haciendo esquina con la calle Acuerdo, entre las calles Norte y Amaniel

Zona de alto tránsito con diversos comercios, entidades bancarias y numerosos locales de hostelería

Muy buenas comunicaciones mediante varios autobuses EMT y Metro estación Noviciado. Cerca del Parking Marcenado Conde Duque y del Parking San Bernardo 48

inv.desc_en:
Premises located on La Palma Street at the corner of Acuerdo Street, between Norte and Amaniel streets.

High-traffic area with various shops, banks, and numerous hospitality venues.

Very good transport links via several EMT buses and the Noviciado Metro station. Close to the Marcenado Conde Duque parking garage and the San Bernardo 48 parking garage.

Includes a food license with a tasting bar. No smoke vent.

Ground floor area: 38.70 m² - Basement area: 33.60 m².

Contract terms: negotiable.
